translations.web: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.
translations.bsb: For just as woman came from man, so also man is born of woman. But everything comes from God.
translations.kjv: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of God.
translations.asv: For as the woman is of the man, so is the man also by the woman; but all things are of God.
